NBA DFS Picks for Monday, November 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, November 9 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 9, 8:51 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) is the top-projected player on the Monday, November 9 DraftKings main slate at 64.5 DraftKings points for $12,000. Nikola Jokic (DEN, 55.9, $11,800) and Victor Wembanyama (SAS, 55.6, $11,300) are next.

Grayson Allen (CHA) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.12 projected points per $1,000 at $5,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 9, 8:51 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
